layout.text: An index and one directory per rejected transaction.

outcomejson.text: Each purpose records both hashes, both runs with their logs, and the class.

indexjson.text: One entry per rejection and per accepting control, written before the runner acts on the comparison. CI requires every refusal exactly once and an accepting control for every role that refused.

offline-correction.text: A capsule replayed offline writes its outcome beside the original, with the recomputed capture identity, never over it.

offline-compiler-diagnostic-t036b.text: For a purpose that printed no user trace, an offline replay with all compiler traces may record a compiler diagnostic beside the original outcome. It is never a reason, never compared with Lean, and never enters a receipt or the index.

obligations.text: The capture identity is recomputed and must match; files are never rewritten; missing files make the rejection incomplete; and in CI a failing row still uploads its replay directory.
